# Updates (version 1.2.2)
- Updated the mcci function to include the test of difference and    equivalence for up to five estimates
- Updated the input argument (of d and se) in the mcci function
- Updated the plot functionality in the mcci function
- Changed the function name (from od.eq.2group to od.1.eq)
- Changed the function name (from power.eq.2group to power.1.eq)

# Updates (version 1.0.0)
- Added optimal sample allocation identification and 
   power analysis for equivalence tests.
- Updated the mcci function to include the test of difference and equivalence 
   for mediation effects.
- Updated the vignettes to include examples of using results estimated from models.


# Initial release (version 0.5.2)
- The mcci function
